channel.title: Hive incidents — Vendor Status Watch

item.title: Home page and action loading issues [resolved]
item.description: Gantt actions loading issue has been resolved. We will be opening a separate incident to track the Home Page loading issue.

item.title: Delayed transactional emails due to third-party provider issue [resolved]
item.description:
On June 2, 2026, some Hive transactional emails were delayed due to an error by our third-party email provider. The provider incorrectly interrupted normal delivery, and limited communication from them slowed resolution.
Paused emails were queued, then released and delivered after service was restored.
We understand this may have had a major impact on your day-to-day operations. We are reducing dependence on our current provider path for critical transactional email by adding: 1. Durable provider-agnostic queueing 2. Redundancy for critical sends 3. Safer switchover controls 4. Better monitoring for delivery delays and failures
Current status: Resolved. Transactional email delivery has resumed, and follow-up reliability work is underway.

item.title: DNS issues for UK region [resolved]
item.description: The incident has been resolved. Availability in known & affected regions is confirmed to be resumed. If you continue to experience issues with loading any hive.com domains, please immediately reach out to help@hive.com and we can assist.
